description:
Set or clear a member's nickname.

Args:
  - guild_id (string): Discord server/guild ID
  - user_id (string): Discord user ID
  - nickname (string, optional): New nickname (empty/null to reset)

Returns:
  Confirmation of nickname change

nickname.description: New nickname (max 32 chars) or null to clear

name: discord_set_nickname
title: Set Member Nickname
